turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please do not worry. Father will take care of everything as you have taught him. I will also help, and together we will ensure that your wishes are fulfilled.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My son speaks true. I have raised you well, my husband, and you will see to it that my last wishes are carried out.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will ensure that everything is prepared as Mother wishes, my lord and lady.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know I am leaving you all with much to manage, but I have faith in you, my husband and son. Do what is right for the family.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please rest assured. Your teachings and sacrifices will guide us, and we will honor your memory by ensuring the family's future is secure.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear wife, do not fear. Your wishes will be honored, and our family will thrive as you have always envisioned.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Father, please let us focus on making Mother comfortable and ensuring her last days are peaceful. We will take care of the rest.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I understand, my son. Let us do all we can to make her last days peaceful and free of worry.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will see to it that your last wishes are fulfilled. Do not worry about us.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am grateful, my children. Ensure that the eldest son marries before I go, and that the family remains united and strong.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please rest assured. I will marry as you wish and will take care of the family with Father.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dearest O-lan, rest easy. The eldest son will marry as you wish, and our family will remain strong and united. I will see to it that your last days are peaceful.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Thank you, my children. I ask only that you follow my wishes and keep the family together.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will do everything in my power to honor your wishes, Mother. Please try to rest now.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will see to all the preparations for the eldest son's marriage, as you wish, Mother. Please rest now.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am grateful, my son and my daughter-in-law. Ensure that the family's future is secure, and always remember the lessons I have taught you.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will make sure every detail is taken care of, as you have instructed, Mother. Please do not worry about anything.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will ensure that my marriage takes place as you wish, Mother. Please rest and know that your teachings will guide me.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am relieved to hear your words, but time presses. We must not delay.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will attend to the arrangements immediately, Mother. Your wishes will be carried out without delay.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]
